killedBy: clearance measurement in the page (issue #1068) throws, naming the selector, rather than measure one that matches several elements or none
why: Drops the check that each chip's selector matches exactly one element, and that element is the chip. Issue #1068 requires it per chip measured: a chip is named by `:nth-child` under the bar, so a second element matching the bar's selector makes every chip line point at two elements, and without the check the first sign would be the bar's own box failing later with a message that names no chip.
